title: Align aictx docs CLI and config behavior
description: Resolve drift between documented aictx commands/config and actual Rust CLI behavior. Audit found documented enable/disable commands missing, --auto parsed but ignored, MCP defaults not written, and generated shell hooks diverging from hand-written hooks.
acceptance_criteria: README, CLAUDE guidance, completions, defaults.yaml, and Rust CLI agree; unsupported commands are removed or implemented; --auto behavior is defined; MCP support is either implemented or removed from defaults.
close_reason: Aligned docs-facing behavior and config: removed stale enable/disable completions/messages, made MCP selections opt-in in defaults, added missing hooks/gemini/copilot defaults, and verified aictx tests pass.

title: Split package upgrades from unattended dotfile sync
description: The hourly autoupdate path can trigger package manager upgrades when update scripts change. Split lightweight dotfile sync from system/package upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Unattended timer does not run apt/dnf/pacman/rpm-ostree/brew upgrades by default; upgrades require manual command or explicit config flag; docs explain the split.
close_reason: Update scripts now skip package upgrades during unattended autoupdate unless CHEZMOI_AUTOUPDATE_UPGRADES=1 is explicitly set; maintenance docs and autoupdate env docs explain the split.

title: Make aictx symlink cleanup ownership-aware
description: Current aictx symlink application removes all symlinks in target resource directories, which can delete user-managed links. Introduce an ownership manifest or equivalent guard.
acceptance_criteria: aictx removes only symlinks it previously created; user-managed symlinks survive apply/reset; regression tests cover mixed owned and unowned symlinks.

title: Make chezmoi autoupdate safe by default
description: Harden unattended chezmoi autoupdate so it never loses local work or mutates Git remotes unexpectedly. Follow-up from repo maintenance audit.
acceptance_criteria: Autoupdate exits safely on conflicts or dirty source state; destructive recovery requires explicit opt-in; remote URL is never rewritten automatically; unattended updates do not run forced applies.
close_reason: Implemented safe default behavior: autoupdate now skips dirty/conflicted source state, destructive recovery requires CHEZMOI_AUTOUPDATE_DESTRUCTIVE=1, remotes are not rewritten, and unattended update no longer uses --force.

title: Add provenance for vendored AI resources and binary plugins
description: dot_aictx, dot_claude, and zellij wasm plugins are tracked content with external provenance. Add machine-readable or documented source/version/checksum metadata.
acceptance_criteria: dot_aictx and dot_claude document upstream source, commit/version, update command, and local patches; tracked zellij wasm plugins document source URL and checksum or are replaced by reproducible install scripts.

title: Convert evolving package installers to run_onchange manifests
description: Several package installers are run_once despite containing evolving package lists, and Windows docs mention Scoopfile.json while installer hardcodes packages.
acceptance_criteria: Flatpak, Windows, and toolbox package flows rerun when their manifests/lists change; Windows installer consumes Scoopfile.json; docs match actual package sources.
